physicalNotes: Radius 0.31 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Giacalone et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1442 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163...99G/abstract): 215,667 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
